Not equal_high_low_restest_fade (job 110, fades a failed restest without neckline break). Not swing_failure_reversal. Not monday_range_sweep_reversal. Not failed_higher_high. Not a rename of double_top.

justification: A confirmed close through the intervening high of two matched swing lows is a different event from a failed equal-high/low restest fade.
